dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what do you want to be in the future?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə bi ɪn ðə ˈfjuːtʃər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd like to be an English teacher, like my parents.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk tə bi ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtiːtʃər, ˈlaɪk maɪ ˈpɛrənts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She wants to be an architect. She loves drawing houses.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈwɑːnts tə bi ən ˈɑːrkɪtɛkt. ʃiː ˈlʌvz ˈdrɔːɪŋ ˈhaʊzɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Emma, what would you like to be?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈbiː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'd like to be a tour guide or a flight attendant. I love traveling!
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk tə bi ə ˈtʊr ˌɡaɪd ɔːr ə ˈflaɪt əˌtɛndənt. aɪ ˈlʌv ˈtrævəlɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: When I was young, I wanted to be a pilot. Now I teach English!
dialogue.reading: wɛn aɪ wʌz ˈjʌŋ, aɪ ˈwɑːntɪd tə bi ə ˈpaɪlət. ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈtiːtʃ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And you're a great teacher, Mr. Brown!
dialogue.reading: ənd jʊr ə ˈɡreɪt ˈtiːtʃər, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn!
